items.title: TRANSMISSIONS DECRYPTED
items.text:
TRANSMISSIONS DECRYPTED
We've managed to decrypt an
important transmission that will help
us avoid the Hollow Men.

Decryption Key: (1)
You may use this card
as a City card of any
color when doing the
Recon or Build Supply
Center action.

Add this to your pool of City card
improvements.

mechanics.effect: Add the Decryption Key sticker to the pool of City card improvements. It costs 1 production unit.

summary: One Decryption Key City-card sticker and the Transmissions Decrypted report that adds it to the City card improvement pool at 1 production unit. The sticker counts as a City card of any color for Recon or Build Supply Center. The icon is a four-color circle. Corner badge is 43.
